discovery_scope: Default public WordPress blog post collection and dedicated post sitemap. Twenty four feature and industry taxonomy routes were discovered and fetched, then explicitly excluded from article scope while preserving raw events.
terminal_evidence: The API advertised 777 posts across eight pages. Every page was consumed, the last contained 77 posts, and page nine returned HTTP 400. gaps: One short post did not pass the automatic 120 word substantive extraction threshold. Its returned content remains retained.
Taxonomy routes are not articles. The crawler frontier includes 24 auxiliary records, whose current state is explicitly excluded_nonarticle.
The first import command failed on an equals sign delimiter inside its query string. The failed attempt remains, and corrected per page imports succeeded.
